overall_rationale: Export volumes and producer output are healthy/record, with CBMM spare capacity (~150 kt vs ~100 kt sales). Posture is Watch—not Normal—because of extreme Araxá concentration plus yellow logistics/contractor labor signals on the truck corridor and Catalão contractors; no confirmed mine/plant interdiction.

logistics_baseline.route: Truck from Araxá → Contagem area → rail → ports (often Santos/Guarujá)
logistics_baseline.form: Containerized pallets/big-bags — not bulk AIS vessel tracking

legend.Normal: Volumes stable/rising; no material disruption signals
legend.Watch: Healthy flow but elevated concentration or yellow labor/logistics/policy signals
legend.Stress: Confirmed production halt, port/rail blockade hitting FeNb, or sharp unexplained export collapse
legend.yellow: Monitor — labor, ESG, policy, or soft disruption risk
legend.red: Hard supply interruption or imminent choke
